description: This file implements logging functionalities such as setting log file paths, writing logs with timestamps and log levels, handling log prefixes, and stripping color codes from log messages. It manages log file creation, ensures thread-safe log writing, and provides utility functions for log management in a C project.

methods.name: void UT_log_setLogFilePath(char * inputFilePath)
methods.description: Sets the log file path and filename based on the provided directory and current timestamp.

methods.name: void UT_log(const char * function,int line,const char * format,...)
methods.description: Logs messages to the file and stdout with timestamp, function name, and line number.

methods.name: void UT_logPrefix(const char * file,int line,const char * prefix,const char * format,...)
methods.description: Logs messages with a prefix, timestamp, filename basename, and line number, and strips color codes.

methods.name: char * UT_stripColorCode(char * in_string)
methods.description: Removes ANSI color codes from log message strings.

ctags.name: UT_log
ctags.pattern: /^void UT_log(const char *function, int line, const char * format, ...)$/

ctags.pattern: /^void UT_logPrefix(const char *file, int line, const char *prefix, const char * format, ...)$/
ctags.signature: (const char * file,int line,const char * prefix,const char * format,...)
